text.value:
INSERT INTO dbo.tbl_Intellimatch_GL_Monthly_Log ([Rowcount], [Filename],  Loaddate)
SELECT COUNT(*) as IntFilecount, Filename, getdate()
FROM ReconControl.dbo.tbl_Intellimatch_GL_Monthly_Staging 
GROUP BY Filename

SELECT COUNT(*) AS 'RecordCount'
FROM [ReconControl].[dbo].[tbl_Intellimatch_GL_Monthly]
WHERE [FileName] = concat(pipeline().parameters.BasePath, '/', @item().name)
AND ((Itemid IS NOT NULL or Itemid <> '') AND (Sourcename IS NULL or Sourcename = ''))
OR ( (Itemid IS NOT NULL or Itemid <> '') AND (nbrDaysPastAvail IS NULL or nbrDaysPastAvail = ''))
OR ((Itemid IS NOT NULL or Itemid <> '') AND (DirectorName IS NULL or DirectorName = ''))

SELECT SUM(cast([rowcount] as int)) AS NumRows
 FROM  [ReconControl].[dbo].[tbl_Intellimatch_GL_Monthly_Log]
